en-US.name: OpenAI CLI
en-US.releaseNotes:
1.53.0 (2026-11-12)
Features
- Vector stores. In openai vector-stores manage, use / to find a loaded store by name or ID. Browse local files or paste a path, then watch indexing progress. Long questions wrap, and wide terminals show matching passages beside results. Press Ctrl+G to expand the workspace or start with --full-screen. #746
- Batches. Press / to filter batches by ID, status, or endpoint. In completed CSV batches, search source rows and answers, then open a match. #742, #745
- Explore. Press Ctrl+G to expand command search. The picker keeps your query and selection. You can also start expanded with openai explore --full-screen. #748
- Speech and images. New speech drafts use gpt-realtime-2.1-mini. The CLI's image saving preset uses gpt-image-2.6-sunburst for generation and edits. OpenAI image variation requests now show how to use image edits. #729
- Responses API. The schema describes the original item ID and removal reason reported by reasoning input transformations. #749
Bug fixes
- Voice Studio. Shortcuts now sit below the panel. Startup avoids stray characters in Apple Terminal. #750
- Images. Fixed gaps in iTerm2 previews. After Ctrl+C, trackpad scrolling returns to terminal history. #735
- Tokenizer. Restores the shell viewport and visible history after resizing in the Linux VS Code terminal. #744
Documentation
- Updated file transcription examples to use gpt-transcribe for plain text and JSON. #743
- Documented how to expand the vector store workspace in the Linux VS Code terminal. #747
Release checks
- The release workflow now verifies the CLI's default models against OpenAI's current guidance before publishing. #739
